<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="25" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="319" y1="19" x2="319" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="16" x2="324" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="13" x2="329" y2="25" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="20" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="16" x2="354" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="354" y1="20" x2="350" y2="24" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="362" y="15" width="19" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="364" y="17" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="382" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="38" cy="65" r="19" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <polyline points="43,58 36,65 43,72" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="65" x2="49" y2="65" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="73" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="700" fill="url(#tinderGradient)">tinder</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y="132" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Welcome to Tinder</text>
    <text x="28" y="159" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">A few simple guidelines help keep</text>
    <text x="28" y="180" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">our community welcoming and safe.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Safety principles -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="204" width="346" height="76" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="22" y="292" width="346" height="76" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="22" y="380" width="346" height="76" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="22" y="468" width="346" height="76" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <circle cx="54" cy="242" r="17" fill="#96E063"/>
    <polyline points="46,242 52,248 63,236" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="83" y="237" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Be respectful</text>
    <text x="83" y="258" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Treat every match with kindness.</text>

    <circle cx="54" cy="330" r="17" fill="#96E063"/>
    <polyline points="46,330 52,336 63,324" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="83" y="325" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Keep it real</text>
    <text x="83" y="346" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Be honest about who you are.</text>

    <circle cx="54" cy="418" r="17" fill="#96E063"/>
    <polyline points="46,418 52,424 63,412" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="83" y="413" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Protect your privacy</text>
    <text x="83" y="434" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Share personal details thoughtfully.</text>

    <circle cx="54" cy="506" r="17" fill="#96E063"/>
    <polyline points="46,506 52,512 63,500" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="83" y="501" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Meet safely</text>
    <text x="83" y="522" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose public places for first dates.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Acknowledgement -->
  <g>
    <rect x="28" y="574" width="18" height="18" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="32,583 36,587 42,579" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="56" y="587" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">I understand and agree to these guidelines</text>
    <text x="28" y="616" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">You can review our safety resources anytime in Settings.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Agree button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="57" y="640" width="276" height="44" rx="62" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="668" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">I AGREE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="716" x2="390" y2="716" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="38,743 49,734 60,743 60,756 38,756" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polygon points="38,743 49,734 60,743" fill="#939393"/>
      <text x="49" y="778" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">HOME</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="128" cy="743" r="10" fill="none" stroke="url(#tinderGradient)" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="135" y1="751" x2="142" y2="758" stroke="url(#tinderGradient)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="128" y="778" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">DISCOVER</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <polyline points="194,740 201,746 208,740" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <polyline points="208,746 201,752 194,746" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="201" y="778" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">MATCHES</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="321" cy="739" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="321" cy="753" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="321" y="778" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>
    </g>
    <rect x="164" y="819" width="62" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
